title: Bitcoin 2012 London: Mike Hearn
summary: Mike Hearn's talk at the 2012 London Bitcoin Conference on the future of Bitcoin, new applications and rebuilding the banking system. He covers lesser-known protocol features such as contracts, escrow and scripting.
why: Recommended as a great overview of what Bitcoin's protocol can do beyond simple payments, particularly contracts and smart property.

quote.text: Mike Hearn's talk at Bitcoin 2012 is a great overview of all that
